name: Tulle
author: E. T. Carter
description: A fine net of lace dots bent by a perspective fall-off and a soft swirl, the marks bunching and shrinking toward a fold the way a sheet of tulle netting hangs and recedes into depth, a radial wave still washing through.

params.label: Mesh spacing
params.effect: Distance between dots in the flat net before draping - a dense fine tulle at the minimum, an open sparse net at the maximum.

params.label: Dot size
params.effect: Radius of the net dots in the near field. Small reads as a fine mesh; large fattens them into bold beads.

params.label: Perspective
params.effect: Strength of the perspective fall-off. 0 is a flat grid; high bunches and shrinks the mesh hard toward the fold, deep into space.

params.label: Fold height
params.effect: Vertical position of the fold the net recedes toward. High puts the vanishing fold near the top like hung cloth; low drops it toward the middle.

params.label: Swirl
params.effect: Soft twist of the sheet about its centre, easing out toward the edges. 0 hangs straight; +/- curls the net like caught fabric.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Spacing of the brightness wave rings travelling through the net; short packs many bands, long sweeps one broad wave.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the wave travels through the draped net; 0 freezes it mid-sweep.

params.label: Ripple count
params.effect: How many concentric brightness rings span the net. Low is one broad slow wave; high packs many tight bands.

params.label: Swell
params.effect: How much a passing wavefront swells the dots. 0 holds the mesh even; high pumps the net dots along the wave.

params.label: Dot brightness
params.effect: Brightness of the net dots themselves. Low keeps them subtle, high makes the draped mesh pop in vivid colour.

params.label: Backlight
params.effect: Strength of the two soft drifting glow blobs behind the net. 0 leaves crisp dots on near-black; high adds a slow colour drift.

params.label: Crispness
params.effect: Edge hardness of the dots. Low is a soft glowing mesh; high snaps the near dots to crisp high-contrast beads.
